test: Compute markdown dollars (shipped value x md/(1-md)) and share of lines marked down by year x category x refrigerant (2016-2025). Track R-410A volume and stock age (WMS running balance / days since last receipt) against R-410A markdowns by month. Compare markdown incidence and depth across channel, taken_by and account manager within the same SKU-year (control for SKU mix). Check whether R-454B and non-refrigerant equipment markdowns concentrate on specific SKUs (discontinued/aged) or spread widely, and when markdowns start relative to the transition.
support: Markdowns near zero outside equipment; R-410A markdowns start/rise around 2023-2025 as R-410A volume falls and stock ages; R-454B/non-refrigerant equipment markdowns concentrated on few SKUs; within-SKU markdown rates flat across channel, taken_by, account manager.
weaken: R-454B and non-refrigerant equipment markdowns grow as fast as R-410A; markdowns predate the transition; within-SKU rates vary sharply by rep/customer/channel; markdowns not related to R-410A stock levels.
expect: Medium confidence the hypothesis partly holds: markdowns confined to equipment and flat across channels/people (likely a SKU-driven rule in a generated dataset), but R-454B and non-refrigerant equipment markdowns ($3.8M each in 2025) suggest it is an equipment-wide markdown, not purely R-410A clearance. I expect the 'R-410A only clearance' framing to be partly weakened.
